title: F-23 residual closure — raw path, short secrets, key fragments, token unification
summary: Closed the audit pushback on the R3-007 'structurally impossible' claim for v5: expanded sensitive-key fragments (credential/passwd/access_key), documented short free-text secret residual honestly, scrubbed security-sensitive artifact payloads on raw partition writes and partX shards, and unified the redaction token to [REDACTED] across prompts and scrub.

sensitive_key_fragments.rationale: DEFAULT_CREDENTIALS / credentials were not masked by field name; passwd is a common password alias without the full 'password' substring; access_key covers AWS-style access key material.
sensitive_key_fragments.rejected_rationale: Too many false positives (credit, accreditation, author, authority).

short_secret_residual.rationale: Bare short secrets without a sensitive key name or provider prefix remain uncaught by both scrubs. Lowering _LONG_TOKEN (>=40) would false-positive on SHAs and normal identifiers. Mitigation is the expanded key-fragment path + provider-prefix regexes, not a shorter bare-token catch-all. Do not claim structural impossibility for this shape.

redaction_token.decision: Unify on [REDACTED] (scrub was already this shape; prompts taught <REDACTED>)

changes_made.description: REDACTION_TOKEN constant; expanded _SENSITIVE_KEY_FRAGMENTS; short-secret residual docstring; part-shard canonicalization; scrub_security_sensitive_artifacts_in_partition_payload helper.
write_json: partition-payload security scrub + path-name security scrub; partX branch applies security scrub (symmetric).
R3-010 residual tests: key fragments, short residual honesty, token unify, part shards, raw write, partX write, write_json wiring pin.

test_write_time_secret_scrub.py.note: 1 intentional skip when generic scrub already catches bare long tokens via credential assignment path

mutation_check_raw_write_json.evidence: Real write_json masks FAKE bare secret in SECRETS_RISK_LOCATIONS raw payload; replacing scrub_security_sensitive_artifacts_in_partition_payload with identity + is_security_sensitive_artifact=False reopens the leak.

residual_risks: Short free-text secrets without sensitive key name or provider prefix remain residual by explicit judgment.

ProcessPool worker _op_write_json path still dumps JSON without write_json() — pre-existing; live success path for the main executor uses write_json via _apply_write_ops. Flagged but not claimed closed here without a separate packet for the worker picklable path.
Does not prove live models obey redaction instructions — write-time enforcement only.
